about: Fixed questions for Ask ReadKernel. Story cases run twice: 'page' asks the bare question from the story page (story key sent), 'typed' is the old way, typing the story into /ask by hand. Keep this list stable so runs compare. Scope cases check that Ask declines anything that isn't tech or AI news (expect: decline) without turning away real news questions and follow-ups (expect: answer); history is earlier chat turns sent with the question, as the chat would.
